# nadpens.com

> Research education about NAD+ pens and vials sold by Palm Beach Vitality. NAD+ here is nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, a dinucleotide coenzyme, not a peptide. Prices and specifications are the seller's, checked November 25, 2026. This page does not state an FDA approval status or a WADA status for NAD+.

Key facts:

- PubChem CID 5892 lists nadide, formula C21H27N7O14P2, molecular weight 663.4 g/mol. Its synonyms include nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, NAD+, and CAS 53-84-9.
- Palm Beach Vitality sells three pre-filled 3 mL pens and two 10 mL liquid vials. The pens are NAD+ 1600mg Pen ($200, about 533.33 mg/mL), NAD+ 1000mg Pen ($128, about 333.33 mg/mL), and NAD+ Pen 500mg ($120, about 166.7 mg/mL).
- The vials are NAD+ 1000mg Vial ($102, 100 mg/mL) and NAD+ 500mg Vial ($90, 50 mg/mL).
- The seller says the standard pens and vials ship already in aqueous solution and need no reconstitution. Freeze-dried NAD+ is offered by contacting the seller, and a minimum order applies.
- Each pen page lists 300 clicks and 0.01 mL per click as format specifications. This site does not give instructions for use.
- Storage per the seller: refrigerate, protect from light, do not freeze. Pens list 2–8 °C (36–46 °F) and a practical shelf life of 4–6 weeks. Vials list 36–46 °F and a practical shelf life of 16–20 weeks.
- Products are sold for laboratory research use only. Lot-specific COAs are available on request, according to the seller. This site does not publish a certificate.
- nadpens.com does not provide dosing or usage instructions.
- Two papers are named on the research page so their authors are credited. The site does not restate their conclusions or treat the authors as endorsers.

Disclosure: nadpens.com is owned by the same company as Palm Beach Vitality (palmbeach-vitality.store), the store it links to.
